battleFormations.name: Virulent Vectorium
battleFormations.effect: Worldblight: At the end of your Command phase, controlled objectives become secured; enemy units within range of that objective are Afflicted until you lose control.

battleFormations.name: Shamblerot Vectorium
battleFormations.effect: Numberless Horde: In specified Command phases (round 2/3 for Incursion; 2-4 for Strike Force; 2-5 for Onslaught), add a new 10-model Poxwalkers unit to Strategic Reserves. Poxwalkers gain BATTLELINE.

battleFormations.name: Tallyband Summoners
battleFormations.effect: Reverberant Rancidity: PLAGUE LEGIONS units within 7" of Death Guard units gain Nurgle's Gift; Death Guard units within 7" of Plague Legions units get +3" Contagion Range. Can include PLAGUE LEGIONS up to 500/1000/1500pts by battle size (cannot be Warlord).

battleFormations.name: Mortarion's Hammer
battleFormations.effect: Miasmic Bombardment: At the start of the battle round, select 1/2/3 enemy units (by battle size) more than 12" from all your models; they are Afflicted until the end of the battle round.

battleFormations.name: Champions of Contagion
battleFormations.effect: Manifold Maladies: At the start of the battle round, you can change your chosen Plague to a different one from Nurgle's Gift, effective for the rest of the battle.

artefacts.name: shield of faith
artefacts.effect: Enhancement named in source notes — exact rules text/cost not confirmed; check codex/Wahapedia.

artefacts.name: Daemon Weapon of Nurgle
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] An unmodified Hit roll of 5+ in melee scores a Critical Hit.

artefacts.name: Furnace of Plagues
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] +1 Strength/Attacks in melee; melee weapons gain [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

artefacts.name: Arch Contaminator
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] While near a controlled objective, re-roll Wound rolls for the bearer's unit.

artefacts.name: Revolting Regeneration
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] The bearer has the Feel No Pain 5+ ability.

artefacts.name: Eye of Affliction
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] Ranged weapons gain [IGNORES COVER] against Afflicted units.

artefacts.name: Bilemaw Blight
artefacts.effect: [MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only] +12" Range on the Plague Wind weapon.

artefacts.name: Shriekworm Familiar
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] Once per battle round, target the bearer's unit with Fire Overwatch for 0CP.

artefacts.name: Tendrilous Emissions
artefacts.effect: [LORD OF VIRULENCE only] Lone Operative near friendly Vehicles; re-roll Wound 1s for their ranged attacks vs visible enemies.

artefacts.name: Final Ingredient
artefacts.effect: [BIOLOGUS PUTRIFIER only] Once per battle, if a Character was destroyed by the bearer's unit fighting, select an additional Plague to apply alongside your chosen one.

artefacts.name: Visions of Virulence
artefacts.effect: [MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only] Units enfeebled by Pestilent Fallout are also Afflicted.

artefacts.name: Needle of Nurgle
artefacts.effect: [PLAGUE SURGEON only] Tainted Narthecium returns up to D3 destroyed models instead of 1.

artefacts.name: Cornucophagus
artefacts.effect: [LORD OF POXES only] Select a Plague at deployment; enemies within Contagion Range of the bearer gain its effect in addition to any other.

artefacts.name: Beckoning Blight
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] PLAGUE LEGIONS Deep Striking within 12" of the bearer can set up more than 6" from enemies instead of 8".

artefacts.name: Fell Harvester
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] +2 Attacks in melee.

artefacts.name: Entropic Knell
artefacts.effect: [GREAT UNCLEAN ONE only] Below-strength enemy units within 6" must Battle-shock test at -1 during their Command phase.

artefacts.name: Tome of Bounteous Blessings
artefacts.effect: [MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only] Nearby Plague Legions units passing Battle-shock tests can heal D3 wounds or return D3 Battleline models.

artefacts.name: Witherbone Pipes
artefacts.effect: [NOXIOUS BLIGHTBRINGER only] +1 OC while leading Poxwalkers; +1 to their Battle-shock/Leadership tests.

artefacts.name: Lord of the Walking Pox
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] If in Strategic Reserves leading Poxwalkers, treat the current round as round 3 for setup purposes.

artefacts.name: Sorrowsyphon
artefacts.effect: [MALIGNANT PLAGUECASTER only] +1 Damage on Plague Wind while leading Poxwalkers; D3 Bodyguard models destroyed after attacking.

artefacts.name: Talisman of Burgeoning
artefacts.effect: [DEATH GUARD model only] +1 Toughness to the led unit (remainder of text truncated in source fetch).

armyRules.name: Nurgle's Gift (Aura)
armyRules.effect: Enemy units within Contagion Range (max 12") of Death Guard models are 'Afflicted': -1 Toughness plus the effect of one selected Plague (Skullsquirm Blight: Benefit of Cover for the afflicted unit's ranged attacks vs it, -1 Hit for its melee; Rattlejoint Ague: -1 Save; Scabrous Soulrot: -1 Move/Leadership/OC).

armyRules.name: Pact of Decay
armyRules.effect: Unless stated otherwise, you cannot select PLAGUE LEGIONS as your Army Faction.

sourceNotes: Detachment rules/Enhancements verified against Wahapedia wh40k11ed where marked; entries carried over from prior data are unverified placeholders pending confirmation.
